import React from 'react'; import { Box, Heading } from 'grommet'; import { StyledCard, InfoText } from '../StyledComponents'; const Commands = () => ( {/* Heading for Voice Interaction Guide */} Voice Interaction Guide for Agama Dashboard {/* Voice Interaction Guide Content */} • When using voice-activated features, follow these steps for optimal performance: {/* Microphone Status Section */} • Microphone Status: - Green Microphone: The system is actively listening.
- Red Microphone: The system is not listening. {/* Providing Input Section */} • Providing Input: When giving input to the Agama AI system, end your query with the word "send" to execute it.
Example: “Tell me her full vital signs history send.” {/* Quick Commands Section */} • Quick Commands: For quick actions like opening or closing tabs or charts, you do not need to use "send."
Example: “Open imaging,” “Close imaging,” or “Toggle dashboard charts.” {/* Quick Commands Section */} • Multi-Tab Commands: You can open multiple popups simultaneously and manage each one independently.
Use voice commands like “Open orders” or “Close vitals” to open or close specific popups.
To close all popups at once, simply say: “Close all tabs.”
You can also move, resize, and collapse popups using touch or mouse controls. {/* Erasing Text Section */} • Erasing Text: To erase all text in the text box, simply say the word "erase". {/* Switching Between Voice and Text Input Section */} • Switching Between Voice and Text Input: You can switch between voice and text input simultaneously without changing any settings. {/* Reminder Section */} • Reminder: If the microphone is green, it is listening. Make sure it is red if you don’t want the system to record your speech. {/* Future Features Section */} • Future Features (Full Version): - Multifunctional Commands: In the full version, you will be able to use commands for multi-view options, editing tab content, and approving or clicking buttons via voice.
- Ambient Mode: The full version will include a selective ambient mode that smartly parses conversation data between patient and physician without fully transcribing every word during consults. {/* Final Note Section */} • Make sure to familiarize yourself with these features for an efficient workflow! ); export default Commands;
